title: Dandadan Season 2 Blu-ray Preorders Are Here And The Collectors Edition Goes Big
content: Dandadan Season 2: Collector's Edition Blu-ray $65 | Releases June 30 Preorder at Crunchyroll Store Dandadan Season 2: Standard Edition Blu-ray $35 | Releases June 30 Preorder at Crunchyroll Store Several new anime series have made a splash in the last couple of years, with Dandadan considered one of the biggest breakout hits.
